description: Animated sheep resource props for the Tiny Swords asset pack. Three behaviour states (idle, move, grass) exported from Sheep.aseprite as horizontal sprite strips.

props.order: After ground tiles, cliff bases, and stair ramps; before top overlays (clouds, etc.).
props.note: Sheep share the y-sorted props layer with trees, bushes, and rocks.

move.note: Walking loop; not used in static example scatter.

grass.note: Grazing loop; used in example scatter.

anchor.note: Bottom-centre of the frame meets the ground tile.

footprint.note: Collision/placement occupies one 64x64 tile; sprite artwork extends above the cell.

usage.summary: Sheep idle animation. Loop all 6 frames at 10 fps.
usage.note: One of three sheep behaviour states from Sheep.aseprite. Example map scatters idle and grass only.

onLandOnly.rule: Place only on land cells (elevation >= 0). Never on water, cliff-face cells, cliff-base cells, or stair/ramp cells.
onLandOnly.appliesTo: Walkable grass at any elevation tier.
onLandOnly.doNotApply: Water (elevation -1), cells below south-facing cliffs, ramp landing/top cells.

preferInteriorGrass.rule: Prefer fully-surrounded centre grass (autotile piece 5, mask 1111) for consistent scatter with other props.
